title: Inside the startup drone maker powering Ukraine's deep-strike campaign
summary: Fire Point, a Ukrainian startup drone maker, is playing a key role in Ukraine's military operations. CEO Iryna Terekh argues that military strength is crucial to achieving favorable diplomatic negotiations.
content: Fire Point CEO Iryna Terekh says Ukraine has "learned the hard way" that military leverage is integral to to bringing diplomacy within reach.

zh.title: 深入乌克兰深度打击无人机制造商的初创公司
zh.summary: Fire Point是乌克兰一家初创无人机制造商，在乌克兰军事行动中发挥了关键作用。首席执行官伊琳娜·特列克主张，军事力量对于达成有利的外交谈判至关重要。
